pages.text: The $(l:armors/sinner_robes)$(c)$(o)Sinner's Robe$() Chestplate has few, but very useful utility and combat Abilities: $(l:blocks/gorger_guts)$(c)$(o)Gorger Guts$() will increase the range from which Items can be picked up, while a $(l:tools/hand_of_greed)$(c)$(o)Hand of Greed$() will increase the Block Interaction Range of the wearer. A $(l:tools/born_to_burn)$(c)$(o)Born To Burn$() will set the wearer on fire and makes attacks ignite enemies.
